## Get started in 3 steps
1
### Create your account
Access your dashboard and generate your production API key.
2
### Copy your API key
Authenticate using a Bearer token from your backend.
3
### Send your first request
Post transaction data to the FX audit endpoint and receive a structured JSON response.
## First request
Direct API endpoint. Custom domain api.ipayx.ai coming soon.
bash
```
# POST /v1/audit — see "Partner Rate Comparison" section for optional partner_rate field
curl -X POST https://hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/fx-audit-engine \
-H "Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_your_key" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d '{
"transactions": [
{
"id": "tx_001",
"source_currency": "USD",
"target_currency": "EUR",
"source_amount": 1000000,
"target_amount": 1018900,
"trade_timestamp": "2026-04-15T14:30:00Z"
}
]
}'
```

## Authentication
Authenticate every request using your production API key in the Authorization header.
`Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_your_key`
Generate and manage your key in the Dashboard. Keys are server-side credentials and must never be exposed in client-side code.

## Endpoint summary
| Method | Endpoint | Description | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | /v1/audit | Returns structured FX audit analysis for one or more transactions, including per-partner score and thresholds applied. | Live |
| GET | /v1/score-config | List scoring profiles | Live |
| PUT | /v1/score-config | Upsert a profile | Live |
| DELETE | /v1/score-config | Remove a profile | Live |

title: ipayx.ai/developers/sandbox
snippet:
# iPayX FX Proof API
Audit FX transactions against the mid-market rate. Returns the hidden spread, true cost, and an FX score (1–10).
Base URL
`https://api.ipayx.ai/v1`
Authentication
`Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_…`
POST
`/audit`
Submit up to 50 FX transactions per request. The API fetches the mid-market rate at the time of each transaction, computes the spread and implicit cost, and returns an FX execution score for the batch.
### Headers
`Content-Type`
string
required
Must be `application/json`.
`Authorization`
string
required
`Bearer ipx_live_…` — generate keys from /developers while signed in.

title: FX Audit API Docs · iPayX Protocol
snippet:
The forensic FX audit engine that powers iPayX. Detect hidden bank spreads vs mid-market benchmark on any currency transaction. Bearer auth, OpenAPI 3.1, signed webhooks.

## Authentication
Every request requires a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Keys start with `ipx_live_`.
HTTP
```
Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx
```
## Base URL
URL
```
https://hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/fx-public-api-v1
```
POST
## /audit
Run a forensic audit on a single transaction. Returns a 0–10 score, hidden spread vs mid-market, and estimated loss.
bash
```
curl -X POST https://hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/fx-public-api-v1/audit \
-H "Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_YOUR_KEY" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d '{
"amount": 50000,
"currency_from": "USD",
"currency_to": "EUR",
"bank_rate": 0.91
}'
```

"commentary": "A 1.85% spread on USD/EUR is significantly above market benchmarks...",
"api_version": "v1"

bash
```
curl "https://hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/fx-public-api-v1/rates?base=USD&quote=EUR" \
-H "Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_YOUR_KEY"
```

title: iPayX MCP Server — Documentation
snippet:
## 3. Authentication
- **Method:** HTTP Bearer token in `Authorization` header.
- **Format:** `ipx_live_xxxxx` (production) or `ipx_test_xxxxx` (sandbox).
- **How to get a key:** [Open your iPayX dashboard → API keys](/dashboard).
```
Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json, text/event-stream
```
